description:
A spare, gallery-caliber contemporary living room photographed at standing-to-elevated eye level with a wide lens in a centered symmetrical composition facing the rear wall. The camera is at approximately five to six feet, level, framing the full room width from the large floor-to-ceiling window on the left to the walnut door on the right.

The room is executed in a rigorously monochromatic warm greige and cream palette. The floor is large-format pale travertine or limestone tiles in a warm cream-beige with barely perceptible vein patterns. The rear wall is clad in floor-to-ceiling panels of limed or bleached wood veneer — possibly wide-plank blonde oak — in a very pale, almost taupe-toned finish. A single walnut-stained door panel is visible at the far right edge.

A very large round coffee table with a white or pale grey marble-look top on a thick cylindrical plaster-white base occupies the room center, its surface holding a sculptural arrangement of smooth white pebble-like ceramic objects and a single dark candle holder. Two very low black leather and matte-black ebonized wood lounge armchairs — a classic angular Continental form — flank the coffee table symmetrically, positioned slightly inward.

A large abstract expressionist line-drawing on canvas in a natural wood float frame leans against the rear wall rather than hanging — a large-format work in charcoal, black, and cream. A second smaller framed abstract work leans beside it at an angle. A single tall dark stone or wood sculptural column or pedestal stands between the chairs.

A large custom area rug in a cream ground with a bold black abstract graphic motif — a figurative linear drawing — spans beneath the entire seating arrangement. On the left, floor-to-ceiling frameless glass panels look out to a bright exterior.

A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
